summary: Iteration 33 — all 3 new nutrition features PASS (backend 11/11 + frontend end-to-end). BACKEND per-user isolation confirmed: goals scoped by user (owner=3000/220 unchanged while member set to 2800/200 via UI + 2500/180 via pytest); custom foods GET is user-scoped (owner cannot see member's food, member cannot see owner's food); cross-user DELETE is a safe no-op (target food remains). Empty name -> 400. Unauthenticated -> 401. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844) verified: (1) MacroRing goals — goal-edit opens goal-calories + goal-protein + goal-save; after save the ring denominators show '/ 2800' and '/ 200', persists after full page reload (API GET returns {calories:2800, protein:200}); (2) Custom Foods — food-add opens list; cf-add opens form with cf-name/cf-grams/cf-calories/cf-protein/cf-carbs/cf-fats + cf-save; saved food appears at top of list as '★ TEST_MyFood'; food-opt-TEST_MyFood adds +300 kcal into the CALORIES input; cf-del-<id> removes the row and the backend list drops to 0; (3) Meal Portions — for a saved meal (TEST_Meal, 100 kcal/20 p), meal-plus-<id> increments to ×2 (row meta scales to '200 kcal · 40p · tap to log'), meal-add-<id> logs base × mult into totals (calories 0→200, protein 0→40); step is 0.5 with min 0.5 (per code). All testIDs from the review request work.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/nutrition.py DELETE /api/nutrition/foods/{food_id} always returns {ok:true} even when no doc matched or the food belongs to another user. Delete is scoped by user_id so it's safe (verified via cross-user delete test), but the client cannot distinguish real vs no-op — consider returning 404 when delete_one().deleted_count==0. Same pattern as meals endpoint (pre-existing).
MacroRing.tsx line 28: goal falsy (0) renders as '/ —', which is nice UX. However, the ring's `over` warning color relies on goal>0; when goal=0 and value>0 the ring stays green (fine).

NutritionCard.tsx: the whole file is ~500 lines and does 3 responsibilities (macros form, foods picker w/ CRUD, meals). Consider splitting into MacroRingPanel, FoodPicker (with CustomFoodForm), MealsList to stay under 400-line rule.

NutritionCard addCustomFood/deleteCustomFood swallow errors silently (empty catch). If POST fails (e.g., 401), the optimistic UI state becomes inconsistent with backend. Consider a small toast or state refetch on error.
